summary.question: Does launching the desktop app with -remote start the Remote device role on the installed build?
summary.channel: operator-driven UI plus agent-read process, socket and Bonjour state
summary.scope: Establishes that -remote starts a Remote device role that a host instance connects to. Establishes nothing about IAction::isRemote, which is located by name only on b9246, and nothing about parser behaviour in that instance.

operator_report.provenance: Reported by the operator in chat on 2026-09-19; the agent did not drive either instance.
steps: Launched VirtualDJ a second time with -remote while the primary instance was running
Connected to it from the primary instance
Changed the Remote skin from the primary instance
observed: The skin change took effect on the -remote instance
not_recorded: How the connection was initiated in the primary instance's UI
Which Remote skin was selected before and after

agent_readings.provenance: Read-only commands run by the agent at 10:16 local time while both instances were up: ps, lsof -iTCP, dns-sd -B _vdjremote8._tcp (3 s browse), PlistBuddy on the app bundle.
agent_readings.reading: The host connected out to the device's port 4243, the same direction and port task 8 observed with an iOS device. The device instance had no listener on port 80; port 80 was already held by the host, so this does not show whether a device instance would serve HTTP if the port were free.

screenshot.provenance: Supplied by the operator; unmodified. Shows the fullscreen device instance (large two-deck Remote skin) behind the host instance's window.
